result.title: NVIDIA GTC 2026: Healthcare Special Address
result.description:
In her special address at GTC 2026, Kimberly Powell, Vice President of Healthcare and Life Sciences at NVIDIA, explores how AI, accelerated computing, and robotics are driving a once-in-a-generation transformation in healthcare. She highlights how open foundation models, agentic AI, and physical AI are enabling new breakthroughs across care delivery, drug discovery, and laboratory operations. By connecting digital dry labs with autonomous wet labs and advancing robotics that expand access to care worldwide, these technologies are accelerating discovery and improving patient outcomes. Together with industry leaders, NVIDIA is building the AI-powered platforms shaping the future of medicine.

result.title: The Infrastructure Behind AI Explained: AI Factory Insider Ep. 1
result.description:

What we cover:
0:00 — Introduction & series overview 
1:31 — Why AI infrastructure demands are changing 
2:41 — What are NVIDIA Enterprise Reference Architectures? 
5:15 — How NVIDIA Enterprise Reference Architectures are built and validated 
9:18 — Industry use cases and customer examples 
12:04 — The three AI factory configurations: RTX PRO, HGX, and NVL72 
17:38 — Key takeaways

result.title: Dell Technologies World 2026 Keynote | May 18–21 | Las Vegas
result.description: Jensen Huang joined Dell CEO Michael Dell onstage to unveil the next-generation Dell AI Factory, powered by NVIDIA.  The spotlight was on scaling AI factories and disaggregated inference using Dell and NVIDIA networking. Jensen shares his vision for the future of computing at #DellTechWorld. From AI factories and accelerated infrastructure to the next evolution of intelligent systems, the architecture of computing itself is being reinvented in real time. Michael Dell emphasized a pragmatic approach to scaling AI, balancing ambition with power availability and data quality.
